Report the metadata a package still needs, with the call that fills it

Source: R/sdp-field-setters.R
review_metadata.Rd

Lists every field that still blocks validate_salmon_datapackage(path, require_iris = TRUE), and prints the exact set_sdp_dataset() / set_sdp_table() / set_sdp_column() / set_sdp_code() call that fills it. Replace the <...> placeholder in the printed call with the real value and paste it – the paste is the audit trail, just as it is for accept_suggestion().

Usage

review_metadata(path)

Arguments

path

Path to the package directory.

Value

An ms_metadata_review tibble subclass, one row per unfilled field, with the package path attached as the review_path attribute. Empty when nothing is outstanding.

Details

This is the companion to review_semantics(), and it sees something that review structurally cannot: a slot with no candidates at all. review_semantics() builds its queue from retrieved suggestions, so a field nothing was found for never appears there. review_metadata() builds its list from the package's own required-field rules, so an empty shortlist and a full one look the same to it.

What it reports:

  • unresolved MISSING DESCRIPTION: / MISSING METADATA: / REVIEW REQUIRED: placeholders in any metadata field;

  • schema-required fields (constraints.required) that are blank;

  • measurement columns missing term_iri, property_iri, entity_iri or unit_iri;

  • tables.csv rows with a blank observation_unit_iri.

It never contacts a network or an LLM.

See also

set_sdp_dataset(), review_semantics(), validate_salmon_datapackage()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pkg <- create_sdp(resources, dataset_id = "demo-1")
review_metadata(pkg)
set_sdp_dataset(pkg, creator = "Fisheries and Oceans Canada")
} # }
